The open loop transfer function of a unity feedback control system is given as $$G(s)=\frac{K}{s(\tau s+1)}$$ Determine the factor by which the gain $K$ should be multiplied so that the overshoot of the closed loop step response will be reduced from 75% to 25%.

rows.topic: Control systems, errors and system types
rows.textLatex: Given a unity feedback system with forward path transfer function $$G(s)=\frac{20}{s^2(s+4)(s+5)}.$$ Find the steady state errors to the following inputs (i) $20u(t)$ (ii) $20tu(t)$, and (iii) $20t^2u(t)$. All notations have their usual meanings.

The unity feedback system with a forward path transfer function $G(s)=\frac{K(s+\alpha)}{(s+\beta)^2}$ is to be designed to meet the following specifications: $e_{ss}\big\vert_{\mathrm{position}}=0.1\,\mathrm{rad}$ ; Damping ratio = 0.5 and Natural frequency of oscillation = $\sqrt{10}$. Find the values of $K$, $\alpha$ and $\beta$.

Moment of inertia of motor, $J_m=1.40\times10^{-6}$ kg-m²

Inertia of the gears is negligible.
Gear ratio, $N_1:N_2=1:100$
The detection is effected by error detectors which produce an error voltage of one volt for every degree change in input.

Damping ratio, $\zeta=0.25$
a) Draw the block diagram of the system
b) Find the steady state gain and undamped natural frequency of oscillation, $\omega_n$

d) Also find the amplifier gain
Explain the physical significance of the term damping ratio for second order control systems.

A unity feedback control system has a forward path transfer function $$G(s)=\frac{10}{s(s+1)}.$$ If output rate feedback is introduced with feedback transfer function $(1+T_as)$, what should be the value of $T_a$ to obtain a closed loop damping ratio of 0.5? What would be the change in the peak overshoot due to introduction of the output rate feedback?

The transfer function of a plant is given by $$G(s)=\frac{K}{s(s+2)(s+5)}.$$ Design a suitable compensator to meet the following specifications:
a) Velocity constant $K_v=10$ sec$^{-1}$.
b) Phase margin $\phi_m\geq35^\circ$.

rows.textLatex: Differentiate between the notions of Absolute Stability and Relative Stability.
By means of Routh’s Criterion determine the stability of the system represented by the following characteristic equation. $$q(s)=s^6+3s^5+5s^4+9s^3+8s^2+6s+4=0$$
The characteristic equation for a certain feedback control system is given below. Determine the range of gain $K$ for which the system will be stable. $$q(s)=s^3+2Ks^2+(K+2)s+4=0$$

For the system described by the following open loop transfer function, sketch the Nyquist plot. Ascertain the range of gain $K$ for which the closed loop system will remain stable using Nyquist Stability criterion only. $$G(s)H(s)=\frac{K(s+1)}{(1-s)}$$

Plot the Root-Locus for a unity feedback system whose characteristic equation is $$q(s)=s^4+3s^3+12s^2+(K-16)s+K=0;\ K\geq0$$ Also determine and indicate on the sketch, i) number and angles of asymptotes, ii) the centroid, iii) the breakaway point/ points, if any, iv) intersection of the root locus and the asymptotes with the imaginary axis, if any v) the range of gain $K$ for which the closed loop system remains stable, vi) any other value that has relevance to the plotting of root locus.

What is a Modal Matrix? Prove that a Modal Matrix can transform a non-diagonal system matrix into a diagonal one.

A linear time invariant system is described by the following state equation. Obtain eigenvalues, eigenvectors and the state equation in canonical form. $$\begin{bmatrix}\dot{x}_1\\\dot{x}_2\\\dot{x}_3\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}0&1&0\\0&0&1\\-6&-11&-6\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}x_1\\x_2\\x_3\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}0\\0\\2\end{bmatrix}u$$

Assume that the state model of a single input single output LTI system is given, where $A$ is the system matrix, $B$ is the input matrix, $C$ is the output matrix and $D$ is the transmission matrix with appropriate dimensions. Obtain the transfer function of the system.

A system is described by $$\begin{bmatrix}\dot{x}_1\\\dot{x}_2\\\dot{x}_3\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-1&-4&-1\\-1&-6&-2\\-1&-2&-3\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}x_1\\x_2\\x_3\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}0\\1\\1\end{bmatrix}u$$ and $$y=\begin{bmatrix}1&1&1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}x_1\\x_2\\x_3\end{bmatrix}$$ Find the transfer fuction of the system.
